# has occupancy

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasOccupancy`](gmeow-hasOccupancy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasOccupancy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Links a location to an occupancy measurement describing the current number of entities located at it. Flat form for the common case; promote to full reified [`Occupancy`](../classes/gmeow-Occupancy.md) when vantage, confidence, temporal scope, or standpoint matter.
